control: Packaged Scarlett FidelityFX 4 upscaler with TuxBox D3D12 and XMem under Proton Experimental.

first_compute_pipeline.source: ACCC/FSPX compute, original embedded root signature, guest device slot 62
first_compute_pipeline.result: Both cold workers compiled the source and both drivers created a compute PSO. The same drivers accepted portable compute DXIL and rejected three damaged FSPX controls (version, section bounds, PSV stage). Only the valid Xbox input requested translation.

abi_controls.device_67: Both adapters returned E_NOTIMPL and cleared the pipeline output for a serialized Xbox descriptor.
abi_controls.device_76: Both adapters created a private 32x32 RGBA8 UAV with guest layout 0x101, resource flags 0x00c00004 and DCC setting 3. GetDesc preserved the guest layout, size, format and flags. Both rejected a nonzero descriptor extension with a cleared resource output.
abi_controls.pipeline_11: The DLL calls the pipeline scratch-blob query at RVA 0x586d and skips the blob on a negative HRESULT. Both adapters returned E_NOTIMPL with a null blob. Both rejected a null output argument with E_POINTER. The standard indirect compute guest completed its 64-word check on both.

before_compiler_optimization.result: DXC timed out at 50 seconds in the initial runtime-worker control.

next_program.error: v_readlane at 0x2358: v1 lane 31 read before any v_writelane

cold_runtime_worker.result: The original upscaler advanced through 26 native GPU pipeline creations. The next shader failed translation. An unhandled command-list slot 85 followed on the failure path.

nvidia.result: vkd3d-proton reported that the requested format does not support the UAV flag during the fourth allocation.

scope: These controls cover provider calls and compute PSO creation. No upscaled image was verified.
